course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice giving soft advice with jag skulle.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague has a small everyday problem and asks for a suggestion.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Offering advice without sounding too forceful.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a simple problem, such as a broken coffee machine, a late bus, or a forgotten errand.

main_focus.name: soft advice with jag skulle
main_focus.description: Use jag skulle to say what the speaker would do in the same situation.
model_examples: Jag skulle vänta lite och se om det löser sig.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use jag skulle naturally 2-3 times as soft advice.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical advice chunks and keep the problem low-stakes.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker describes a small problem and asks for advice.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other speaker offers one or two soft suggestions with jag skulle.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a next step and respond with thanks or relief.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat jag skulle with different simple verbs

focus: which advice option seems most practical and why
the next step chosen after the advice

sentence_focus: one sentence asking what someone would do
one sentence with kanske kan du
one sentence reassuring that it is not a big problem
one sentence combining advice with a hopeful outcome
